'''Cambylictus berries''', or '''camby berries''' for short, were a treat eaten by [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] and celebrants of the [[Festival of Love]]. They grew on [[Cambylictus tree/Legends|Cambylictus]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]], native to [[Endor/Legends|Endor]] and [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].

==Description==
[[File:ChocolateCoveredCambyBerries.png|thumb|[[Chocolate/Legends|Chocolate]] covered camby berries.]]

Camby berries were picked from [[Cambylictus tree/Legends|Cambylictus]] [[Tree/Legends|trees]], which were native to the forests of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. They were considered to be naturally tart. Cambylictus trees were also known to grow on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].<ref name="SWG" /><ref name="SWCL" />

==History==
{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
During the Festival of Love of [[1 ABY/Legends|1.5 ABY]], [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|purchased]] these berries from [[Logray/Legends|Logray]] in the various celebratory [[City/Legends|cities]], including [[Theed/Legends|Theed]], [[Kaadara]], [[Tyrena/Legends|Tyrena]], and the [[Southern Ewok Lake Village]]. These spacers would often dip these berries in [[Chocolate/Legends|chocolate]] fountains to give them a delicious flavor.<ref name="SWG" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
In the [[Star Wars video games|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', Cambylictus berries were introduced to the game during the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Festival of Love]] of [[2008]]. In the game, [[:w:c:swg:Camby Berries|Camby berries]] could be purchased for 2,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. However, it should be noted that this price was probably a mere game mechanic, and may not reflect the true cost of the berries. In the game, Camby berries could be dipped in [[Chocolate/Legends|chocolate]] fountains located at the celebratory [[City/Legends|cities]]. Doing so converted the camby berries into chocolate covered Camby berries.

Camby berries were once again sold during subsequent [[:w:c:swg:Ewok Festival of Love|Festival of Love]] celebrations in [[2009]], [[2010]], and [[2011]]. Camby berries may have been inspired by [[Wikipedia:Fragaria|strawberries]], which are commonly dipped in [[Wikipedia:Chocolate|chocolate]].
